component.name: RICO
component.summary: Play Minecraft and manage your instances, mods and worlds

description.p: RICO is an open-source Minecraft launcher with support for multiple game versions, mod loaders, modpacks, skins and playing with friends.
Keep separate instances with their own mods and settings. RICO downloads the Java runtime and game files each instance needs.
RICO is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
